last.verdict: Moderna swung to a profit on strong international COVID sales and raised its revenue outlook, but much of the cash boost is borrowed money.

takeaways.label: Profit and higher outlook
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 29% to $1.3B, mostly international COVID sales, and net income was $162M versus a $200M loss. 2026 revenue growth is now seen at 15–25%, up from up to 10%.

takeaways.label: Cash boost is mostly debt
takeaways.text: Year-end cash is now seen at $8.1–8.3B, up from $4.7–5.2B. About $2.6B of that came from new convertible notes, and most Q3 sales are still uncollected.

takeaways.label: Melanoma vaccine win
takeaways.text: With Merck, intismeran plus Keytruda cut the risk of melanoma recurrence or death by 42% in Phase 3. Regulatory filings and a possible launch are being prepared.

takeaways.label: Flu approval, limited launch
takeaways.text: The FDA approved the mRNA flu shot mFLUSIVA in August, but it launched only in limited form this season because approval came after the annual contracting cycle.

history.verdict: Norovirus vaccine setback outweighed a smaller-than-expected loss and lower costs.

reasons.label: Norovirus vaccine setback
reasons.text: Phase 3 norovirus vaccine missed early-success bar; more patients must be enrolled, delaying it.

reasons.label: Pipeline over numbers
reasons.text: Revenue is only $145M, so the stock trades on upcoming flu and melanoma news.

reasons.label: Cost cuts, cash runway
reasons.text: Spending outlook trimmed about $0.2B; year-end cash now seen at $4.7–5.2B.
